newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC raises wheat crop estimate to 34.3 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: ONIC raises wheat crop estimate to 34.3 mln tonnes.

text.p: France produced a record wheat crop of 34.347 million tonnes this year, cereals office ONIC said on Wednesday.
The agency said it had raised its estimate from an earlier forecast of 33.8 million, breaking further ground above a 1984 record of 32.6 million.
It projected exports of soft wheat to countries outside the European Union of 6.8 million tonnes compared with a previous forecast of 6.7 million tonnes.
In 1995/96, France produced 29.825 million tonnes of soft wheat, and exported 3.75 million tonnes outside the EU.
In a published report, ONIC also raised its forecast for wheat exports within the 15-nation EU to 8.3 million tonnes from a previous 8.0 million.
Last season France sold 8.613 million tonnes to EU states.
ONIC said it expected a slight reduction in soft wheat stocks at the end of the current season to 2.127 million tonnes from 2.230 million on June 30, 1996.
It had previously projected stocks of 2.193 million tonnes.
Export and carryover stock figures apply to the European marketing calendar running from July to June.
